### Figure 1A

-   A: Explained variance after MOFA

It is adapted from MOFA2::plot_variance_explained, to allow different font sizes.

```{r}
MOFAobject.trained <- load_model(here(output_dir, "Figure1A_MOFA_model_copy.hdf5"))

# AI assisted code. AI-generated with GPT-5.6 Luna, 2026-10-08: filter MOFA2 factors with >1% R2 in at least two datasets. Debugged by Hanneke
filter_mofa_factors <- function(mofa) {
  r2 <- mofa@cache$variance_explained$r2_per_factor$group1

  keep <- rowSums(r2 > 1) >= 2
  factors <- rownames(r2)[keep]

  mofa_subset <- subset_factors(mofa, factors = factors)

  return(mofa_subset)
}
# End AI-assisted code

MOFAobject.trained <- filter_mofa_factors(MOFAobject.trained)

data.frame(MOFAobject.trained@cache$variance_explained$r2_total[[1]])
data.frame(MOFAobject.trained@cache$variance_explained$r2_per_factor[[1]]) |>
  round(2)

figure_1a <- plot_variance_explained(MOFAobject.trained, x = "view", y = "factor")
figure_1a <- update_ggplot_fontsizes(figure_1a)
```


### Figure 1B

-   B: correlations with proliferation for factors 1, 2, and 7

```{r}
factors <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure1BC.csv"))

proliferation_plot <- function(factor_name, list_idx = 1) {
  cor_nr <- round(
    cor(factors[["ProliferationRate"]], factors[[factor_name]],
      method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
    ),
    2
  )
  print(str_c("Spearman correlation between ProliferationRate and ", factor_name, " is: ", cor_nr))

  p <- factors |>
    ggplot(aes(x = ProliferationRate, y = .data[[factor_name]])) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_label(
      x = 2.5,
      y = max(factors[[factor_name]]),
      label = str_glue("r[s] == {cor_nr}"),
      label.size = NA, parse = TRUE
    ) +
    labs(x = "proliferation rate (70/doubling time)", y = factor_name)

  return(p)
}
plot_multiple_proliferations <- function(factor_list) {
  plot_list <- imap(factor_list, function(x, idx) proliferation_plot(x, idx))
  plot_grid(
    plotlist = plot_list,
    nrow = 1
  )
}
figure_1b <- plot_multiple_proliferations(c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Factor7"))
figure_1b
```

### Figure 1C

-   C: correlations with subtype for factors 1, 2, and 7

```{r}
subtype_plot <- function(factor_name, list_idx = 1, use_color = FALSE) {
  p <- factors |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Subtype_4_categories, y = .data[[factor_name]])) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 15, h = 0, w = 0.2)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = factor_name)
  if (use_color) {
    p <- p +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
      aes(color = Subtype_4_categories) +
      scale_color_viridis_d() +
      guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
  }

  return(p)
}
plot_multiple_subtypes <- function(factor_list, use_color = FALSE) {
  plot_list <- imap(factor_list, function(x, idx) subtype_plot(x, idx, use_color))
  plot_grid(
    plotlist = plot_list,
    nrow = 1
  )
}
plot_multiple_subtypes(c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Factor3", "Factor4"), use_color = TRUE)
plot_multiple_subtypes(c("Factor5", "Factor6", "Factor7"), use_color = TRUE)

figure_1c <- plot_multiple_subtypes(c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Factor7"))
figure_1c
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=3}
ggplot(factors, aes(x = Factor1, y = Factor2)) +
  geom_point() +
  aes(color = Subtype_4_categories) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

### Figure 1D-E

-   D-E: weights/loadings of features for factors 1, 2

```{r}
weights <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure1DE.csv"))

names(MOFA_color_palette) <- views_names(MOFAobject.trained)

plot_top_weights <- function(factor, n_features = 20) {
  factor_nr <- str_extract(factor, "\\d+")

  p <- weights |>
    slice_max(abs(.data[[factor]]), n = n_features) |>
    mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = rev(feature))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[factor]], y = feature, color = view)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = 0)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(x = str_glue("Factor {factor_nr} weight"), y = NULL, color = "omics layer") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    scale_color_manual(values = MOFA_color_palette) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed")
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
figure_1d <- plot_top_weights("Factor1")
figure_1d
```

```{r}
figure_1e <- plot_top_weights("Factor2")
figure_1e
```

### Figure 1F

```{r}

figure_1f <- metabolite_rates_unscaled |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = `Glutamine uptake (µm/gDw/h)`,
    y = `Glutamic acid secretion (µm/gDw/h)`
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
  geom_text(label = "1:1", x = 40, y = 50, color = "black")
figure_1f
```

### Figure 1 combined

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
figure_1 <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(figure_1a + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)),
    plot_grid(
      figure_1b,
      figure_1c,
      ncol = 1, labels = c(NA, LETTERS[3])
    ),
    nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 2), align = "h", labels = LETTERS[1:2]
  ),
  plot_grid(figure_1d + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    figure_1e + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    figure_1f,
    nrow = 1, align = "h", labels = LETTERS[4:6]
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  rel_heights = c(1.5, 1)
)
figure_1

(output_file <- here(output_dir, "Figure_1.png"))
save_plot(output_file, figure_1, base_height = 0.7 * page_height, base_width = 1.1* page_width)
```
